newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Resources Devt to buy SembCorp units.
newsitem.headline: Resources Devt to buy SembCorp units.

text.p: Building supplies company Resources Development Corp Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy certain subsidiaries and associated companies of industrial conglomerate SembCorp for Singapore $99.5 million.

Resources Development said in a statement the acquisition was undertaken as part of a restructuring of SembCorp to establish Resources Development as the listed property, leisure and building materials arm of SembCorp.

As part of the deal, Resources Development had agreed to assume funding commitments and corporate guarantees for the acquired companies of approximately S$33.3 million and S$14.6 million respectively.
The deal would be partly financed through a one-for-one rights issue which would raise net priceeds of approximately S$74.3 million and also through a bonds-cum-warrants issue of S$100 million.

Resources Development said the aggregate cost of S$132.8 million would also be partly financed through the sale of S$65 million-worth of its shares (ex-rights) to Paterson Land Lte Ltd and to Sembawang Industrial Pte Ltd.
It said it intended to expand its business in property in Singapore and the region and invest in industrial parks and leisure and lifestyle resorts.
The acquired companies were involved in the development of properties in Singapore and industrial parks in China, Vietnam, Indonesia and in India, it said.

The main purpose of the bonds issue was to raise medium-term funds at a favourable effective interest rate to be used to finance various construction and property projects, pay off loans and for working capital.
